tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'gyur med ye shes dngos/ /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs shing*/ /ming dang tshig las rab 'das pa/ /chos dbyings de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /spros med brjod pa dang bral ba/ /chags thogs med pa'i gnas lugs ni/ /rnam pa kun tu 'char ba yi/ /ye shes de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtags pa'i dri ma kun bral yang*/ /dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor thams cad pa/ /brda' las don dam mtshon pa'i tshul/ /yang yang spel ba 'di re mtshar/ /de ltar bla ma lha bcas la btud nas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /kun la nyer 'khor dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /sgrub thabs 'bri bar 'gyur ba su yis 'gog /'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyud sbyang ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ nges par bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid sgrub thabs nyams len gyi skabs su nges par dgos pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gsum mo/ /de yang*/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhārma swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcol ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bhā wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/

mahā sa ma ya satwa a hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur pa/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje rnams dbyer med du gyur/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu ni/ rdo rje'i zhal dag rigs drug dgod pa dang*/ /rdo rje bzhi dang yan lag drug rnams 'god/ /bdud tshogs gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ /mkha' la rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rtogs byas ste/ /bla med mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mchod/ /lam bsten stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥpradz+nyā u pa ya/ āt+ma ka kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa te/ ma ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+raṃ/ badz+ra a mṛ ta swa bha waṃ/ ku ru ku ru skan+dha dhā tu ā ya ta naṃ niḥswa bhā waṃ swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtsug tor gyi steng du waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de zhu ba lus la zhugs pas gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi mthar thug pa'i ma dag pa'i lus sbrul gyi shun pa ltar lan gsum dor te/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes rnam par dag pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba dri ma med pa ltar gyur/ gnyis pa rigs drug 'god pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

dpral bar oṃ dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po me long bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ snying gar hūṃ nag po las don yod grub pa rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/ thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ lte bar hoḥser po las rnam par snang mdzad rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gugadagra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥsngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang so sor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ gsum pa rdo rje bzhi dag pa ni/ lag pa phan tshun mnye zhing dkrug pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/

oṃ hraḥsarba as+t+rā rā dza/ mā ra kle sha an+ta ka ra/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa duḥkha ts+tshe da ma ma ka raṃ bi sho dha ya swāhā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la sogs pa rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ a i ṛ u l̥/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ a e ar o al/ steng gi tshigs rnams su/ ha ya ra wa la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su/ lā wā rā yā hā/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su āl au ār ai ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su hūṃ gi yi ge mthon mthing*/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag las grub pa'i lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gtsug tor nas brtsams te lus thams cad la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa te badz+ra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+raṃ badz+ra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa yan lag drug dgod pa ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ oṃ hl̥̄ hri da yā ya na ma/ dpral bar reg nas/ oṃ hrūṃ si ra si swāhā/ gtsug tor du reg nas/ oṃ hriṃ shi khā yai bau ṣaṭa/ yan lag rnams la reg ste/ oṃ hrīṃ ka ba tsā ya hūṃ/ mig gnyis la reg ste/ oṃ hrāṃ nai tra ya wa ṣaṭa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyogs bcur brdabs la/ oṃ hraḥ.as+t+ra ya phaṭa/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya hri da ya si raḥshi ka wa tsa nai tra/ a tra badz+ra/ ṣaṭa aṃ ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lnga pa bdud tshogs gzhom pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dha swa bhā wa sarba dharmān bi sho dha ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma pa bo dha ka sarba dharmān pra bo dhā ya swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmān pra dī pa ya swāhā/

oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmān badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhuṃ/ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wā ra ya/ e daṃ bā ling*/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da da ma he/ sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raṃ/ ā gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā da tu/ bi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra ka sarba satwa naṃ/ shān+taṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣa a wa ra ṇa/ gub+tiṃ/ ka ro tu/ i daṃ satwā naṃ/ t+yak+t+wa ba h+ye man+ḍal bhu myāṃ tiṣ+ṭha tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra adz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ khyi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ grong gi bdag po ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ shī gh+rāṃ/ i daṃ bā ling*/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhuk+t+wa bi twā trib+tiṃ/ kri twā sarba satwā naṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ tsit+taṃ/ kri twa/ a pa ra s+thā naṃ/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swāhā/ 'di ni sgrub mchod kyi bdag bskyed sogs la dgos kyi/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa'i skabs kyang 'di bor bas rung la byed pa'i lugs la'ang gang rung re byas na yang legs so/ /gnyis pa dngos ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥdamar po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan kyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ nag po las rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa dang*/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥser po las rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ ljang khu las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa dang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣaḥsngon po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams su gyur/ de bzhin du/ las kyi 'khor lo rnams dang*/ bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams dang*/ dbang po rnams dang*/ las kyi dbang po rnams la rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/

de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ de nyid las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i me dpung steng dang 'og tu ljang khu dang sngon po/ shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po/ nub dang rlung du ser po 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnams kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs phyogs bcu na gnas pa mtha' dag nges par bsregs nas bde ba chen po la bkod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ hrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥ ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarba a pa ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kā yi ka bigh+nan bi nā ya ka ā dī nāṃ/ da sha dika ga tā nāṃ/ kā ya wāk+tsit+tā ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhasmin ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs drag tu 'don no/ /drug pa srung pa'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ oṃ paṃ bi shwa badz+ra pad+maṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ dbus kyi lte ba'i nang du khru bcu gnyis pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya badz+ra sūr+ya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ pad+ma'i lte ba khru bzhi pa'i steng du/ de dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa las/ sku mdog nag po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ zhal thams cad mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba can/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/

spyi bor thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung ste gyon zhing*/ bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal ba cod pan la bcings shing*/ rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings pas gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyud dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa/ de ltar bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ hūṃ kro dha in+d+ro3haṃ kro dhā nāṃ ādz+nyā dā ya ka swāhā/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi nang du/ raḥyig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ha ya ra wa la brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ha hā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag yongs su gyur pa las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba mi bskyod pa lta bu dang*/ gnod mdzes rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu dag zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ steng dang 'og tu rtsibs kyi nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la gnas pa'o// yi yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can don yod grub pa lta bu dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang me'i rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/

las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dang ṭak+ki rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ wu wū las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang ba mtha' yas lta bu dag lce dang chu lam nas spraus te/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ ll̥ ll̥̄ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che rnam par snang mdzad lta bu dag bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung gi rtsibs su gnas pa ste/ thams cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing*/ khro bo'i dbang po lta bu'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣa tsakra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā uṣ+ṇi ṣa ur+dhi dī shi rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yaṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bigh+nan an+ta ka pūrba di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ raṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza dzaṃ bha ka duṣ+taṃ pradz+nyā an+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ waṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+ma an+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ laṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza s+t+waṃ bha ka ya ma an+ta ka pash+tsi ma di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ lāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā bā la bā ya byāṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ wāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la i shā na di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ rāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki nai ri t+yāṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la dan+ṭa ag+na yaṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ hāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza sum+bha a dho di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

de dag gis kyang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings pa rnams kyi steng du/ rdo rje phur bu rno zhing rab tu 'bar ba/ stod khro bo'i gzugs can rnams kyis btab par gyur/ phur bu bsgril pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa te ṣaṭa mu kha/ ṣaṭa bhu dza/ ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa/ sarba bigh+nan bi nā ya ka ā di duṣ+tāṃ naṃ/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā nā ni/ kī la ya kī la ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu 'debs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ll̥̄ badz+ra mud ga ra mā ra ā dī nāṃ/ sa ra si kan+ṭhe hri da ye nā bhau gu h+ye/ an+te badz+ra kī la kā na/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣīṃ k+ṣuṃ k+ṣūṃ k+ṣl̥ṃ k+ṣl̥̄ṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur zhing*/ lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par gyur/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhiskā rā ya sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhu paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai wi t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ha s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra wā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ de yan chad la/ rgyun gyi nyams len la bsdus pa kho na la dga' bas lha dgu'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /bdun pa tshogs kyi zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po'i 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/ brgyad pa mchod pa rnam pa bdun ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mā le mū la ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhu pa ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī pa ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te nai we t+ya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye was+t+ra a bha ra ṇa pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ha s+ya ghaṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra wa t+ye wa t+ya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye nṛ t+ya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra kā me sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa naṃ kro dha a dī nāṃ/ badz+ra su ra ta pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams dar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/

/rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnams bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ / dgu pa lam bsten pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spong ba'i/ /rtsa ba gsum dang phar phyin bcu/ /tshad med bsdu dngos bzhi bsten bgyi/ /mi dge bcu dang sgrib pa lnga/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang zag pa bzhi/ /deng nas brtsams te spangs par bgyi/ / bcu pa stong pa nyid la dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /sgom pa bsgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pa/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ khams gsum po rnam par dpyad na cir yang mi dmigs pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi chu'i khams kyis me rnam par nyams shing*/ me med pas sa yang sra ba nyid dor nas lan tshwa bzhin du zhu bar gyur te/ /chu la thim zhing*/ chu yang rlung gis bskams par byas nas rlung gi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la mi snang bar gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a na bhiskaṃ ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku rdzogs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog

thig le rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba rdzogs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa/ zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa pad+ma'i mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyang steng dang 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du maṃ las ri rab lhun po de'i steng du k+ṣaṃ las sna tshogs chu skyes lte bar pad+ma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du haṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las zhes pa'i sa bon gyi ye ge yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten gyi khams snga ma bzhin du grub par gyur/ lhun po'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la bh+ruṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du rin po che nag po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po'i ra ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa ste/

sgo dang mnyam pa'i sgo khyud dang*/ sgo 'gram dang*/ sgo logs te glo 'bur gyi rnam par grub pa'i sgo khang nyid do/ /ra ba'i phyi rol du stegs bu dkar po 'gram stegs kyi rnam pa can khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba dang*/ ra ba'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po kha bad kyi rnam pa can la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa dang*/ de'i steng du thog phubs kyi gdung 'degs pa'i ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa dkar po me long dang rnga yab dang bcas pa/ steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i bā ku li dang*/ steng du mdzes par mtshar du dngar ba'i kra ma shir+ṣa dkar po'o/ /sgo khang rnams kyi steng du sgo las sum 'gyur gyi rta babs nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum dang*/ sgo logs kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu'i steng du btsugs pa'i ka ba ser po bzhi bzhisabategs pa rnams te/ brtsegs ma re re la'ang gdung dang myos pa srung ba dang*/ ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ 'og gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /de la brtsegs ma dang po'i logs gnyis nas glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dag dang*/ brtsegs ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i logs gnyis nas mchod pa'i lha mo dag gis gdung 'degs bzhin pa dang*/ steng du har mi mdzes pa bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa/ bum pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang*/ rnam bu rnams las dril bu dang*/ me long dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rnga yab la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma nye bar dpyangs pa ste/ gzhal yas khang gi zur rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ sgau dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams kyi zur la rin po che dus mas mdzes par spras pa'o/ / phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi phyed du bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /de'i yang nang gi phyed du oṃ yig las byung ba'i gtso bo'i pad+ma dang*/

de'i lte ba la ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba dang*/ ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma dang*/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa ste/ gnam stong gi mthar nyi zla gnyis ka gzas 'dzin pa dang*/ rtsa gsum gcig tu gyur pa'i dag pa'o/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la bung ba'i mdog can gyi ka ba bcu drug ste/ shar du ral gri'i 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa bzhi dang*/ lhor rin po che'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang*/ byang du pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang*/ nub tu 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi'o/ /ka ba de rnams kyi nang gi thad sor yang gtso bo'i pad+ma la gru bzhir bskor ba'i ka ba bcu gnyis te/ phyi nang gis ka ba de dag gis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung rim pa gnyis kyi nang ma nag po dang phyi ma ljang khu'o/ /nang gi ka ba rdo rje'i gdung dang bcas pa'i steng du yang ka ba rnams kyis btegs pa'i gtso bo'i gnas kyi thog phub phyur bu'i rnam pa mdzes pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /ra ba'i nang du snying po'i sgo'i drug cha spang par lha rnam dkar po'o/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma 'og gzhi sngon po dang*/ de nas mchod pa'i sa'i mthar thug pa'i 'og gzhi rdo rje'i sa dang*/ steng gi thog rnams kyi mdog ni/ gtso bo'i zhal gyi dbye bas/ shar nag po/ lho dmar po/ byang dkar po/ nub ser po'o/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la pad+ma dang bum pa bzang po la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma nye bar 'khrigs pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu sa'i 'khor yug gi steng gi nam mkha' la dbang ldan nas zla ba nya gang ba 'char bzhin pa dang*/ bden bral du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol tu chu dang me dang rlung gi 'khor yug rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu nam mkha'i khor yug la dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i yongs su bskor ba ste/

de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol phyogs kun nas rdo rje me lce ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba'o/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i ka ba rnams kyi bar bar du oṃ yig las skyes pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lha'i gdan du gyur pa rnam pa brgyad de/ phyogs bzhi dkar po dang*/ mtshams bzhi dmar po'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du yang bdud rtsi'i bum pa brgyad kyi gnas so/ /lha rnam la shar dang lho'i g.yas dang g.yon dang*/ byang du nub kyi g.yas rnams su oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ mtshams rnams dang*/ byang dang nub kyi g.yon dag tu/ oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ shar dang byang gi sgor pad+ma dkar po dang*/ lho dang nub kyi sgor pad+ma dmar po'o/ /pad+ma dmar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lo'i phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nya bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang*/ dkar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar gnam stong bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis so/ /me dang rlung gi 'khor yug gi mtshams su dur khrod chen po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa brgyad do/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po kun nas dwangs zhing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba dus mas mdzes par gyur/

gnyis pa brten pa lha sgom pa la gnyis las/ dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la aṃ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor dang*/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā aḥ zhes pa rnams g.yas skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ l+la y+ya ḍ+ḍa ḍhaḍha/ l+la y+ya s+sa ṣ+ṣa zhes pa rnams g.yas skor dang*/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dz+nya dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ྈྐ sha ṣa ྉྤ sa/ ha ya ra ba la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa haṃ yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing*/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam pa brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying khar mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍa ma ru/

g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying khar mnan pa/ bdud gyi dga' ma dang*/ drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo ba med par gnas pa/ sku mdog sngon po g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po mche ba phyed gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ste/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ / ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang*/ rdo rje rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje mgul rgyan dang*/ rdo rje gdub bu dang*/ rdo rje ska rags dang*/ rdo rje rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o// de rnams re re la yang phyag mthil nas brtsams te tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po rnams nag po/ gnyis pa rnams dmar po/ gsum pa rnams dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gugadamar po bzhis/ mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhis 'khor lo mdung dbyug pa dgra sta rnams 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje dril bu/ phub kha ṭ+wāṃ ga kha bye ba/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis gzhu zhags pa rin po che pad+ma dkar po bzhis dung me long rdo rje lcags sgrog

tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin cing*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum ser mo zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad/ spyan bcu gnyis ma ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nub zhal gtso bor bzhag pa lta bu/ mdun zhal ser mo/ g.yas zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug lcags kyu sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ bgrang 'phreng rnams 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ rin po che rnams 'dzin pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril zhing*/ des kyang snyoms parazhugs pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan brgyad ni 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa ste/ shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lhor aṃ āḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las rim pa bzhin du bdug spos kyi snod dang*/ dri'i dung dang lha bshos dang*/ mar me phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang*/ me dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan dang bden bral du haṃ hā rnams yongs su gyur pa las rnga yab phyogs kyi mdog can rnams so/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ nag dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis bdug spos dang*/ tsan dan dang*/ gur gum dang*/ gla rtsir bcas pa'i ga bur gyi snod dang*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ yongs 'dus me tog dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/

dmar ser dkar nag pa'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis mar me dang*/ do shal dang*/ cod pan dang gdub bu dang*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gos dang*/ ska rags dang*/ rin po che'i rna rgyan dang*/ /rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ dkar nag dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'o ma dang*/ chu dang sman bzang po dang*/ chang rnams kyi snod dang*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi dang*/ grub pa'i bcud len dang*/ bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang*/ 'bras chan rnams kyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ ser dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyis g.yas pa rnams kyis dung dang*/ gling bu dang*/ nor bu dang*/ ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa rnams kyis pi waṃ dang*/ rnga dang*/ 'khar rnga dang*/ zangs dung rnams 'dzin pa/ mer du ba ma nag mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab nag po brgyad bsnams pa/ bden bral du smig sgyu ma dmar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dmar po brgyad bsnams pa/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma dkar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dkar po brgyad bsnams pa/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab ser po brgyad bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gyi mdog ni g.yas skor gyi rim pa ste/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can no/ /'di dag gi rgyab tu yang*/ dbang ldan du oṃ las byung ba'i chos kyi dung dkar po dang*/ bden bral du āḥlas byung ba'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi dmar po/ mer hūṃ las byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu nag po/ rlung du hoḥlas byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams spro ba ni/ 'dod chags chen po gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/

yum la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo yab yum thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid las 'phros te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang ldog nas slar yang rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa nag po la spyan ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ṛ yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po chen 'byung ldan dmar po la/ mā ma kī dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lhor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ u yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas dkar po la gos dkar mo dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ l̥ yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad ser po la/ sgrol ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ lnga char yang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gdan gyis gnas shing*/

thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /ī yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las sgrol ma nag mo la rnam par snang mdzad ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ṝ yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las gos dkar mo dmar mo la snang ba mtha' yas dkar pos 'khyud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ū yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las mā ma kī dkar mo la rin chen 'byung ldan dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ l̥̄ yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo la don yod grub pa nag pos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma'i gdan gyis gnas shing shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de dag gi g.yon dang g.yas su yang hi hī hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ rnams yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing*/ pad+ma'i kha brgyan pa brgyad de shar du rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lhor khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ haṃ haḥlas byung ba'i steng du khu ba 'gags pa'i bum pa dang*/ 'og tu rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa rnams su gyur/ haṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ljang khu la/ haḥyig las byung ba'i shin tu sngon pos 'khyud pa/ steng phyogs su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ yaṃ yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las bgegs mthar byed nag po la/ laḥyig las byung ba'i rengs byed ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod pa gyur/

raṃ yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po yongs su gyur pa las shes rab mthar byed dmar po la/ waḥyig las byung ba'i khengs byed ma dkar mo 'khyud pa/ lho sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ waṃ yig la byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa la pad+ma mthar byed dkar po la/ raḥyig las byung ba'i rmugs byed ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang sgaur pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ laṃ yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed ser po la/ yaḥyig las byung ba'i shin tu brtson 'grus ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ khro bo khro mo brgyad po de rnams zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu brdzes pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ klu'i dbang po dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ shar dang byang gi sgor pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ lho dang nub kyi sgor pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang dang*/ khro bo'i lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gis gnas shing thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ / steng gi khro bo ma bskyed kyang mi 'gal lo/ / a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las phyag na rdo rje ljang khu la sgra rdo rje ma sngon mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ e yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i snying po nag po la dri rdo rje ma ser mo'i 'khyud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ar yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ sa'i snying po dmar po la/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/

'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po la/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang gi g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ al yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser po la/ reg bya rdo rje ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub kyi g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ aṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po sngon po la/ chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khus 'khyud pa/ shar gyi g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gdan gyis gnas shing thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /ā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khu la/ kun tu bzang po sngon pos 'khyud pa/ nub kyi g.yon du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ai yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo la/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ār yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar pos 'khyud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ au yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo la/ sa'i snying po dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ āl yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ dri rdo rje ma ser mo la/ nam mkha'i snying po nag pas 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ āḥyig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo la/ phyag na rdo rje ljang khus 'khyud pa/ byang gi g.yon du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/

thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma'i gdan gyis gnas shing*/ shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de ltar na de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste/ don yod grub pa/ sgrol ma/ bgegs mthar byed/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma/ nam mkha'i snying po/ reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po

nas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ gos dkar mo/ shes rab mthar byed/ rmugs byed ma/ sa'i snying po/ ro rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po nas/ 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ 'od dpag med/ mā ma kī pad+ma mthar byed/ khengs byed ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyugagazugs rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang*/ sku mdog dkar po nas/ bgreng 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rengs byed ma/ sgrib pa rnams sel/ dri rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos khams rdo rje ma rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma ni rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa'o/ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu la/ shar du dri ma dang 'phreng ba ma nag mo/ lhor bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma dmar mo/ byang du bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo/ nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo/ steng du sgra ma dang gar ma ljang gu/ 'og tu 'dod ma dang glu ma sngon mo ste/ thams cad kyang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs shing*/ gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ / de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ su bi shud+dha dharma dha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ / gnyis pa snying rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug par gyur/ de nas phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying gar rab tu zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa'i sems can de rnams mchog gi dga' ba dang bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ de dag re re zhing yang skad cig gis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣu k+ṣl̥ las phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang*/ k+ṣā k+ṣī k+ṣū k+ṣl̥̄ las khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang*/ k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣar k+ṣo k+ṣal k+ṣaṃ las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang*/ k+ṣā k+ṣai k+ṣār k+ṣau k+shāl k+ṣaḥlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang*/ k+ṣ+la las las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang*/ k+ṣ+lā las las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog ni/ lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dhū tī'i lam du hoḥyig dag dang*/ dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/ hoḥyig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/ gtum mo shes rab kyi chags pas yab yum gnyis zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas// bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste/

/rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ / gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ / sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces pa glu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slad du bskul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ huṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan zhing mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo sna tshogs yum gyis 'khyud pa'i skur gyur pa dang*/ 'dam ma brgyad la nus ma brgyad/ phyi rol kyi grwa bzhi la rdo rje bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis bzhengs par gyur pa ni/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gis pad+ma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma sreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma ru/ /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang*/

/dril bu phub dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje'i sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'khyud gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud/ /nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan dan gur gum dang ni ga bur snod/ / dril bu pad+ma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdu bu ste/ /g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen rna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi'i grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras chan snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍa ma ru/ /pi wang rnga dang mkhar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig sgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma// rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gag pa 'dud/ / tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen sgrub dga' ba bzhi/ / lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa// skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi/ /chos kyi dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ / yang na de rnams sngon bzhin bskyed kyang chog go / yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams dang*/

dkyil 'khor pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ aṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por bzhugs par gyur/ i ī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang*/ ṛ ṝ las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang*/ u ū las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang*/ l̥ l̥̄ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang*/ hi hī hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥrnams so/ /haṃ haḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang*/ yaṃ yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang*/ raṃ yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po dag dang*/ waṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang*/ laṃ yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po dag dang*/ a aṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang*/ e ai las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang*/ a ār las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang*/ o au las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang*/ al āl las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang*/ aṃ ā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang*/ rnams te/ de rnams so sor yongs su gyur pa las/ khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs can dri chu dri chen rab 'gags pas/ /'chi med rab ster 'chi med rgyun gyis mngon par gang ba'i thod pa'am/ /zla ba'i rang bzhin zla ba'i 'od ltar rab tu dkar ba'i bum pa ni/ /bdud kyi tshogs 'joms bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis shin tu gang ba rnams la 'dud/

/'du byed rlung dang ngag gi dbang po sna dang reg gzhan 'dus ma byas/ /don yod sgrol ma bgegs kyi dgra dang nam mkha'i snying po reg bya ma/ /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum phub dang dpal ldan thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga / nyi zla'i gdong ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs sa yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ / tshong ba me dang lag pa'i dbang po mig dang ro gzhan bde ba che/ /rin chen dbang po gos dkar mo dang rmugs byed sa yi snying po ro/ /mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan nyin mor byed 'dra chu yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /'du shes chu dang rkang pa'i dbang po lce dang gzugs gzhan ye shes sku/ /snang ba mtha' yas mā ma kī dang khengs byed 'jig rten dbang po gzugs/ /tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum pad dkar me long dang ni bgrang 'phreng can/ /nag dang dmar ba'i gdong ldan dkar po me yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /gzugs kyi phung po sa dang bshang lam lus dang dri gzhan 'od gsal gzugs/ /rtag pa spyan ma rengs byed dang ni rnam sel dri yi rdo rje ma/ /'khor lo dbyug pa khro bo'i rdo rje dung dang lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag / dkar nag gdong ldan gser gyi ri 'dra rlung gi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /rna ba chos khams yid dang sgra gzhan gsang ba'i dbang po dri chu gzhan/ /phyag rdor chos khams kun bzang sgra ma gtsug tor shin tu sngon mo sbyor/ /nyi zla'i zhal ldan ljang dang sngo ba rdo rje gri gug dgra sta dang*/ /dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i gdong ldan stong pa'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dkar chu skyes mdangs bkra'i ze'u 'brur 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje'i gdan dang g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs rgyal dang rgyal sras khro rgyal dang*/ /'dam skyes dmar po'i ge sar snying por ri bor 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs rigs ma rnams dang rdo rje ma rnams la phyag 'tshal/

/de ltar lha yi 'khor lo legs mchod dri dang 'phreng ba bdug spos ma/ /snang gsal bdud rtsi 'bras bu ma dang sgeg mo bzhad ma sil snyan ma/ /gar dang glu yi sbyor ba la brtson 'dod ma 'dod la rab dga' ma/ /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur du mas yid rab 'dzin ma rnams bstod do/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i phung po khams sogs gzhan/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /glo bur dri ma'i sbub las nges grol te/ /srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig / 'dir yang steng gi khro bo mi bskyed na/ rna ba chos khams sogs bstod chen gyi dkyus ltar bya'o/ / de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs zhal bzhi pa 'jigs pa'i sku can rab tu bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgra drag po sgrog pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ shes rab dang thabs las byung ba/ gtso bo bzhin du mtshon cha rnams dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i pags pa'i gos can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thod pa lnga dang*/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ sprul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa nam mkha'i khams su spros te/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing*/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams rdo rje zhags pas bcings nas/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis sdigs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ khro bo'i dbang po slar yang rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhu paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai we t+yaṃ/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra ha s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wa t+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṝ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī tāṃ/ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥhī/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpral bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin cing*/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang*/ mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dam ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing*/ g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis pad+ma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum gyis nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin cing*/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang*/ snying gar aṃ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dril bu/ ral gri/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa rnams 'khod pa las rab tu spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ sku'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang*/ gsung rdo rje dang*/ thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rts-i'i bum pa'i bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar gyur/

dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje= /sku yi rdo rje= /byin rlabs gnas= /dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje= /gsung rdo rje= /byin rlabs gnas= /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje= /gsung gi rdo rje= /byin rlabs gnas= /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje= /thugs ky-i rdo rje= /byin rlabs gnas su= /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// mi phyed rdo rje= /thugs kyi rdo rje= /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs sh-ing*/ rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ shes rab kyi lte bar hoḥlas sku rdo rje/ gsang bar swā las gsung rdo rje/ gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pa dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan la 'od dpag med dang*/ don yod grub pa la rin chen dbang pos rgyas btab par gyur pa'i dag pa'i phung po chos gos dang gtsug tor 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin du ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa dang*/ nag po rnams la don yod grub pa dang*/ dmar po rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ dkar po rnams la snang ba mtha' yas dang*/

ser po rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ sngon po rnams la rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ lha thams cad kyi gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la a yig mi bskyod pa dang*/ snying khar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la i yig don yod grub pa dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ yig rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la u yig snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la l̥ yig rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la aṃ yig rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ lha rnams kyi lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams su sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams la l̥ u ṛ i a'o/ /lha rnams kyi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su/ zla ba'i nyi ma sgra gcan dus me'i dkyil 'khor rnams la oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ'o/ rdo rje nor bur gzhom du med pa'i a yig go /

gsum pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las lte ba'i hoḥyig glog dang mtshungs pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor phung po lnga'i rlung dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor khams lnga'i rlung rnams bsregs shing*/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams kyang gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams la 'jug pa bsregs nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba las glo bur du thig le'i rgyun babs pa mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ snying gar sleb pas mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas/ oṃ dz+nyā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ slar yang ji ltar byon pa bzhin du steng du gshegs pas/ lte bar rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang*/ snying gar rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang*/ mgrin par skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ dpral bar dri ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra satwā haṃ durdan+ta da ma ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs kyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis gong bzhin bstod/ de nas lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'am bzlas pa bya'o/ /de yang da ltar lag len la snying po gtso bor bzla bar snang zhing*/ rtsa sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo shes rab ma dar bcas pa'i sngags oṃ swāhā/ zhes pa bye ba bzlas pas bsnyain pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yang na oṃ aḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pa'am/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ

hrāḥswāhā/ zhes pa rnams gang yang rung ba zhig bye bar bzlas pas kyang bsnyen pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang*/ nyer bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la mchod pa rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ bzlas pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis bzhin mchod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ / sogs 'dud nyer gcig gis bstod/ spro na gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs kyis kyang bstod/ gsum pa ni/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dang*/ snying gar rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa'i lte bar nus ma rnams dang*/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa'i lte bar phung po dang khams bzhi'i lha dang*/ mgrin par rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar skye mched bcu gnyis khro bo bzhi dang bcas pa lus dang bsam pas rab tu dbye ba rnams gshegs su gsol/ de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod nas/ thun mtshams la 'jug go/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang*/ gtor ma bshams/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dha tī shwa rī/ ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi shwa dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi bi shwa dha ya hūṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba'i mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang mar/ lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du ū las dri chu/ nub tu li las dri chen/

rlung mtshams su l̥̄ las glang po che'i sha dbang ldan du ū las ba glang gi sha bden bral du ṝ las rta'i sha me mtshams su ī las khyi'i sha dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs gong bzhin/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sogs/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sogs/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs gong bzhin brjod pa ni gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drang ba ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sras bcas g.yog 'khor dang*/ /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha hā hi hī badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ā kār+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hri da yaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phreṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ gyi bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa bhiska rā ya/

sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ i daṃ/ ba līṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsa ā ga t+ya/ sa pa ri wa ra/ shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā dan tu/ pi ban+tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛp+tāḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān+taṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣa/ a ba ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ/ kurban+tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ uṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+nan an+ta ka nī la dāṇ+ḍa/ pradz+nyā an+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza/ pad+ma an+ta ka a tsa la/ ya ma an+ta ka/ mahā ba le bh+yaḥ gri gug gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ ā kā sha ba yu/ te dza/ u da ka pri thi wī/ sā dhi bh+yaḥ ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ prah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu/ nai ri t+ya/ ba yu/ ya ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dra/ ī shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ ra hu kā la ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ bu dha/ maṃ ga la/ shu kra pri haspa ti/ ke tu/ sha ni bh+yaḥ pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas la / oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma karko ṭa ka wā su ki shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+me bh+yaḥ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ be ta ḍa/ bi kri ta mu kha/ shwā/ kā ka sū ka ra/ gṛdh+ra/ byā gh+ra/ ū lu ka dzaṃ bu ka ga ru ḍa/ mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ bā liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya/ sa pa ri wā raḥ shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ bā liṃ/ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā dan+tu/ bi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trip+tāḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shīn+taṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣa/ ā ba ra ṇa gub+tiṃ/ kurban+tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya tī swāhā/ phyi mchod ni/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhīskā rā ya/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhu paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai bi t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ

badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra wā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhuṃ/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde drug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang*/ /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma 'di dag len zhing gsol ba dang*/ /btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis/ /'gro la zhi rgyas bsrung skyob sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ / bar 'dir chos skyong ye shes pa rnams la so so'i gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ āḥhuṃ/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ bā liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ pra dī paṃ sogs/ yul bdag gi gtor sngags dang 'dra ba la 'don pa spos pas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ yul bdag grong bdag la yang gong bzhin gtor ma 'bul ba las/ a pa ras+thā naṃ gats+tsha zhes pa'i dod du/ swas+thā gats+tsha gats+tsha swāhā/ zhes bsgyur ba ni khyad par ro/ / oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ / sogs kyis 'phrin las gzhol/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*/

/mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*/ /sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun du ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig / ces shis pa brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim/ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aṃ yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo dang*/ dpral bar ṛ yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo dang*/ mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo dang*/ /snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo dang*/ lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtugs shing*/ /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar/ /rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ /de rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching*/ /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/

/dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig / de nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sogs dang*/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ / sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ / sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / ces sogs smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab par bya'o/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnal 'byor gzhan rnams kyang nyams len gyi skabs su ma chad pa gal che'o/ / 'dir smras pa/ rdo rje rnam bzhi'i yid bzhin nor/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi thabs mkhas kyis/ /dri ma rnams bzhi sbyangs pa las/ /sku bzhi'i 'od zer spro ba'i thabs/ /mngon sum ye shes lam byed dang*// rjes dpag mos pa'i lam byed gnyis/ /rgyal bas rgyud sde mtha' dag las/ /gsal ba gsungs la nges brnyes nas/ /snying por gyur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus min 'di/ /gsal bar bris las dge ba gang thob pa/ /des ni mtha' yas 'gro ba 'di kun yang*/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyud sde'i mthar thug 'di la mos shing*/ bskyed rim gtso bor byed pa rnams la shin tu mkho bar mthong zhing*/ don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //zhus dgabakra shis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ -PAGE 286--PAGE 287--PAGE 285- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
